title: ComputationSpec
description: Language-independent specification of the computation to build, produced by the Intake agent and consumed by every downstream agent instead of the user's raw source material.

name.description: Short, lowercase, underscore_separated identifier for the computation, e.g. 'histogram', 'prefix_sum'. Used to derive function names.

description.description: One or two sentences: what the program computes.

inputDescription.description: The exact input(s): types, shapes/sizes, and a concrete deterministic generation strategy (e.g. a seeded PRNG formula).

correctnessCheck.description: The exact output(s) and what makes an output right, stated so a program can check it mechanically.

parallelDecomposition.description: The natural unit of parallel work, and whether iterations/chunks have true data dependencies.

problemSizes.description: One or more suggested problem sizes, large enough to make timing/race effects observable, small enough to run unattended.

assumptions.description: Anything inferred or guessed rather than stated by the user, flagged explicitly. Empty array if none.
